ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated at the distal tips and outer left lobe margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated on the outer distal region of the left lobe and focal white clusters at both fluke tips; the central and inner lobe areas exhibit uniform low-intensity black/grey values.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric serration profile; left lobe features high-frequency jagged peaks near the tip transitioning to smoother undulations towards the notch; right lobe exhibits larger, distinct saw-tooth peaks along the central trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge from the median notch extending to the tips; lower margins exhibit a smooth convex curve meeting at the peduncle region.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast (white) pixels localized at both far-left and far-right fluke tips, forming irregular geometric masses consistent with localized colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the mid-left lobe surface, breaking the solid dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization creating high-relief surface textures at both fluke extremities; irregular white scarring patches visible on the mid-outer section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jaggedness on the extreme distal edge of the right lobe, forming three distinct vertical points prior to the terminal barnacle cluster.
